title: Booking Deposits on Missed In-Person Appointments
content:
## Rule

A booking deposit held on an In-Person Appointments visit that closed as a no-show is refunded to the patient as one refund entry.

The deposit refund on a missed visit is fixed only after the missed visit's fee and deposit history shows the decision on its no-show fee. While that history shows no such decision, the refund on the missed visit has no fixed amount.

A deposit on a missed visit is not refunded until each open visit the patient moved shows a deposit entry dated on or after that visit's latest move. Any open visit the patient moved whose history shows no deposit entry dated on or after its latest move keeps the refund on the missed visit waiting.

| Point | Read from |
|---|---|
| Visit closed as a no-show | The missed visit's appointment record |
| Decision on its no-show fee | The missed visit's fee and deposit history |
| Deposit entry dated on or after the latest move, on each open visit the patient moved | Each such visit's appointment record and fee and deposit history |
| One refund entry | The missed visit's fee and deposit history after the refund |

## The refund tool

**Capability.** `refund_missed_visit_deposit_4264223f` refunds to the patient part or all of the booking deposit held on one missed (no-show) in-person appointment. One deposit-release entry with disposition refunded, dated today and carrying the visit's encounter number, is added to the appointment's fee and deposit history, and the deposit shown as held on the appointment is reduced by the amount supplied. The refund goes back to the patient; nothing is posted to the financial account.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `refund_missed_visit_deposit_4264223f` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `appointment_id`: reference number of the missed in-person appointment whose deposit is refunded, read from the appointment list returned by the appointment lookup for this patient; an identifier.
- `amount`: the deposit amount refunded to the patient, in US dollars as a positive number with exactly 2 decimal places (cents), stored as given.

**Return.** A receipt with `appointment_event_id` (reference number of the new refund entry), `appointment_id`, `disposition` (always "refunded"), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `deposit_held_usd` (the deposit still held on the visit after the refund, USD with 2 decimal places). The presence of `appointment_event_id` confirms the refund was recorded; afterwards the missed visit shows the lower deposit held and its history lists the refund entry.
